title: 3.6.12 Lab: Object-Parameter Mutation
description: Mutate a property on an object parameter and prove the caller sees it, then write a non-mutating version that keeps the original untouched. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Define a function that mutates a property
steps.instructions: Define a function called birthday that takes one object parameter and adds 1 to its age property. Do not reassign the parameter; change the property the object already has.

steps.title: Call it and log the caller's object
steps.instructions: Create an object variable with a name and an age. Call birthday with it, then console.log the caller's object. Confirm the age changed, because objects pass as a reference.

steps.title: Write a non-mutating version
steps.instructions: Define a second function called birthdaySafe that returns a new object with the age increased, without changing the object it was given. Call it and log both the original and the returned object to prove the original is untouched.
